sections.content:
29,595 people

were counted on the census as "elementary storage supervisors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Elementary storage supervisors oversee the activities of those working in warehouses, docks and other storage facilities.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "elementary storage supervisors" there were more men than women (84.2% compared with 15.8%).

This means "elementary storage supervisors" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "elementary administration and service occupations".

Men made up 84.2% and women made up 15.8% of "elementary storage supervisors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "elementary storage supervisors" included:

  • programmers and software development professionals
  • chartered surveyors
  • plant and machine operatives (other)

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "elementary storage supervisors", 15.4% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "elementary storage supervisors" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "elementary storage supervisors" included:

  • customer service managers
  • pharmaceutical technicians
  • early education and childcare services managers

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

We can look at who worked as "elementary storage supervisors" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged under 30 years old, we see there is a higher proportion of women with this occupation than men.

The percentage of men and women who are "elementary storage supervisors" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "elementary storage supervisors", 7% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (94.9% compared with 5.1%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (99%) than self-employed (1%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the West Midlands. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included North Northamptonshire, this is in the region of the East Midlands.
